431:t_1:84.en:
$$クロウ$$
「No... All I saw was $n running off without a word of greeting... or rather, running away.」

431:t_1:85.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Did you say something to him?」

431:t_1:86.en:
$$トライア$$
「Just some grown-up advice for a young man. ...Though it may have been unwanted meddling.」

431:t_1:87.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Looks like even Chief has taken a shine to that kid.」

431:t_1:89.en:
$$クロウ$$
「For some reason I can't leave $n alone when I look at him... Apparently it stirs up my born-to-draw-the-short-straw side.」

431:t_1:91.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Still, winning over even Chief the Ogre... That kid's talent scares me.」

431:t_1:92.en:
$$トライア$$
「If it weren't for your debt, I could be a lot nicer to you, you know.」

431:t_1:94.en:
$$トライア$$
「About 864,500 G. Bring me more Reactor data and I'll pay you a good price for it.」

431:t_1:95.en:
$$クロウ$$
「...So, time we got down to business.」

431:t_1:100.en:
$$トライア$$
「...Sorry. Just wait a little longer.」

431:t_1:101.en:
$$トライア$$
「I will save $$エスター$$, no matter what.」

431:t_1:103.en:
$$クロウ$$
「...Well... if Chief says so, I'll believe it.」

431:t_1:104.en:
$$クロウ$$
「But are you sure? To hear $$桂$$ tell it, you're pretty busy...」

431:t_1:105.en:
$$トライア$$
「Just who do you think I am?」

431:t_1:106.en:
$$クロウ$$
「OK. I'm counting on you, Chief.」

431:t_1:107.en:
$$トライア$$
「Even you managed to bring out the full power of the $$リ・ブラスタＴ$$. I'll do it too.」

431:t_1:108.en:
$$クロウ$$
「...We'll be heading out for $$セントラル・ベース$$ soon.」

431:t_1:109.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Though I expect the trip there to be one headache after another.」

431:t_1:110.en:
$$トライア$$
「$$クロウ$$, I... believe you can do it.」

431:t_1:111.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Knock it off with that stuff. It makes me worry there's a catch.」

431:t_1:112.en:
$$トライア$$
「...I wonder if we'll see each other again...」

431:t_1:113.en:
$$クロウ$$
「If a lousy old bond like ours could be cut that easily, I wouldn't be suffering.」

431:t_1:115.en:
$$トライア$$
(That's how it is, $$エスター$$... So wait just a little longer...)

431:t_1:122.en:
$n
「We might never see each other again, but please take care...」

431:t_1:123.en:
$$マキ#pilot$$
「This time we can say a proper goodbye, both of us.」

431:t_1:130.en:
$n
「...I guess it's better to settle it than to leave it half-finished inside me...」

431:t_1:131.en:
$$ティティ$$
「You mean... that person, right?」

431:t_1:133.en:
$$ティティ$$
「...I heard about Miss $$スズネ$$ from everyone.」

431:t_1:135.en:
$$ティティ$$
「Hang in there. It's no fun when $n is down.」

431:t_1:139.en:
$n
「If I ever become unable to fight, whether from backlash or any other reason, get me back on my feet by whatever means necessary.」

431:t_1:140.en:
$n
「Drugs, $$インプラント$$ surgery, either one is fine. Use every means available.」

431:t_1:142.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Understood. Now that I have confirmed your own wishes, I will do as you say.」

431:t_1:149.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「...I won't give you up to anyone.」

431:t_1:150.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Your existence is a double-edged sword for me. That's why... I'll keep you by my side forever.」

431:t_1:151.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Not even to $$アウストラリス$$... You are the last attachment left inside me.」

431:t_1:152.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Even if it brings about my ruin... I... won't give you up to anyone.」

431:t_1:154.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「$$セツコ$$... I want to... kill you.」

431:t_2:4.en:
$$隼人$$
「Stop it, $$竜馬$$. Howling here won't reach $$アドヴェント#pilot$$.」

431:t_2:5.en:
$$竜馬$$
「That's not it! I'm angry at myself, for trusting that bastard right up until today!」

431:t_2:6.en:
$$弁慶$$
「If you put it that way, all of us made the same mistake.」

431:t_2:7.en:
$$葵$$
「But it's strange... that all of us believed in him so completely.」

431:t_2:8.en:
$$甲児$$
「When I learned $$アドヴェント#pilot$$ was alive, it reminded me of $$アイム・ライアード$$, and I had a few doubts, but...」

431:t_2:9.en:
$$甲児$$
「Even that faded as time went by.」

431:t_2:10.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「You could say it's only natural. The more contact we have with someone, the more our trust in them naturally grows.」

431:t_2:11.en:
$$シモン$$
「So the newcomers like $$レド$$ were looking at him with a much cooler eye, huh?」

431:t_2:14.en:
$$レド$$
「...I don't quite understand it myself.」

431:t_2:15.en:
$$レド$$
「As for that man $$アドヴェント#pilot$$, I neither trusted him nor felt that much distrust toward him.」

431:t_2:16.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「I also confirmed that, as this unit was monitoring Ensign $$レド$$'s mental and physical responses.」
